backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing a Tesla car dealership system with inventory management, user profiles, customer inquiries, and order processing, using role-based access control (admin/user permissions) and Map-based storage for cars, users, inquiries, and orders.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the signup page fix for Internet Identity authentication and user profile creation, referencing ProfileSetupModal.tsx and multiple components with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files for the Tesla Experience application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS variables for light and dark themes, including background, foreground, accent, and semantic colors for the design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with "Tesla Experience" title and root div for React application mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, cars, admin, payment, order confirmation, signup, login, and profile pages, wrapped with ThemeProvider, QueryClientProvider, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Access denied screen component displaying a shield icon, error message, and link to cars page for users without admin privileges.
Features section displaying three feature cards (acceleration, autopilot, range) with IntersectionObserver-based scroll-triggered fade-up animations.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with social media icons (X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube), copyright notice, and Caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/GallerySection.t: Interactive 3D gallery section displaying three car images with hover-triggered 3D rotation and scale transforms using CSS perspective.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Navigation header component with scroll-based styling, authentication-aware menu items (Home, Features, Cars, Admin, Profile), and smooth scrolling to page sections.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Auto-rotating hero carousel with three slides showcasing Tesla features, each with background images, titles, and action buttons that scroll to corresponding page sections.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication toggle button that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
Fixed-background parallax section displaying 'Innovation Meets Design' heading with overlay styling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for new user profile creation, collecting user name and saving profile data via Internet Identity with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/ScrollCarAnimati: Scroll-triggered animation that moves a car image horizontally across the screen based on scroll position.
frontend/src/components/VideoSection.tsx: Video section with intersection observer for fade-in animation, displaying a placeholder image with play button overlay.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useMutations.ts: React Query mutations for setting car availability and creating orders, with automatic cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching inventory, inquiries, orders, admin status, and user profiles from the backend actor with actor availability checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for theming (colors, spacing, borders) in both light and dark modes, plus custom animations and base styles for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays customer inquiries, orders, and inventory in tabs, with access control checking if the caller is an admin and allowing toggling of vehicle availability status.
frontend/src/pages/CarsPage.tsx: Vehicle inventory listing page that displays available Tesla models in a grid with images, details, and buy buttons, featuring intersection observer animations for card reveals.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that handles Internet Identity authentication, checks for existing user profiles, and shows a profile setup modal for new users before redirecting to the cars page.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that displays a success message with the order ID after a successful purchase, providing navigation options to view orders or browse more cars.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentPage.tsx: Payment checkout page that displays order summary for a selected vehicle by VIN, collects payment card details, validates authentication, and processes the order creation before redirecting to confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/SignupPage.tsx: Signup page component that handles Internet Identity authentication, checks for existing user profiles, and shows a profile setup modal for new users before redirecting to the cars page.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: User profile page displaying authenticated user information, avatar, principal ID, and order history table with car models, VINs, prices, and dates.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with sidebar/chart colors, custom animations (accordion, fadeInUp), and container settings.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a Tesla car experience website with video hero slides, scroll animations, 3D gallery, user authentication, admin dashboard, and e-commerce functionality for vehicle sales.
